purpose: Present independently reported Tesla cockpit measurements, FSD trip-meter evidence and confirmed-Park accounting, with an exportable session-boundary certificate.
primaryGoal: Inspect the selected vehicle's available physics evidence without treating unknown measurements as zero or its FSD trip meter as an engagement flag.

dataSources.behavior: Vehicle-scoped, enabled only with a vehicle; cancellation signal forwarded; physicsKeys.cockpit and live query policy. Handler combines LiveState with ten minutes of park-field timeline; returned numerics remain SI. Page uses useDataState with live provenance.

Vehicle-scoped live query with cancellation. Combines LiveState and up to thirty minutes of motion timeline. Historical timeline failure is logged but a successful heartbeat response is still returned. FSD distance is a meter, not an engagement indicator.

Historical query, vehicle-scoped and cancellable. Page supplies no date bounds; handler defaults to now minus thirty days through now and requests at most 1000 drives and 1000 charges. Client downloads the returned object unchanged. Actual repository completeness and signing configuration were not established.

dataSources.endpoint: Not independently traced in this bounded audit
dataSources.behavior: URL vehicle ID, persisted selected vehicle and first-fleet fallback are reconciled by the existing shared hook. The page creates no competing picker. Fleet request/error UI was not traced.

states.loading: Cockpit passes isLoading to its brief; heartbeat/park SourceContent provide contextual loading skeletons.
states.empty: Heartbeat and park have named empty messages. Cockpit retains all nine metric slots with nullable inputs, but no explicit no-vehicle prerequisite.
states.error: Cockpit fatal error has QueryError/refetch; heartbeat and park use SourceContent fatal-error recovery without blanking neighboring sources.
states.staleOffline: Cockpit and heartbeat derive retained DataState and mount StaleRefreshWarning. SourceContent supports retained body/retry. Certificate has no equivalent state presentation.

issues.detail: Certificate availability is represented only by data truthiness. Initial failure/loading/no vehicle all produce the same disabled export; retained certificate after a failed refresh remains downloadable with no stale/error context. Certificate is also excluded from the page query metadata at line 76.
issues.fix: Derive historical certificate DataState and expose localized loading, prerequisite, fatal recovery and retained-data context beside the export using existing primitives. Preserve export eligibility for actual retained source data and export the full raw certificate unchanged.

issues.detail: When vehicleId is absent, all physics queries are disabled. useDataState has initial status without data, but cockpit overrides brief loading with isLoading; the resulting source label can say Loading source while showing unknown metric values indefinitely. Heartbeat and park instead show no-evidence empty messages, not the missing vehicle prerequisite.
issues.fix: Distinguish fleet loading and missing selected vehicle from enabled source loading and resolved-empty evidence. Keep all section shells and existing header-owned vehicle selection; use SourceContent.emptyContent or existing EmptyState with localized prerequisite guidance, not another picker.

issues.detail: A null last_tick_at is always described as No trip-meter tick in the recent window. The heartbeat handler can log a history-read failure and still return HTTP success with live state, so this response does not prove recent-window history eligibility or completeness.
issues.fix: Retain the trip-meter distinction and nullable timestamp. Report unknown recent-window coverage honestly; any explicit history-eligibility indicator requires an integration-owned contract rather than page-invented data.

visualIssues.detail: Heartbeat and park place a self-contained OperationalBrief/GlassPanel inside LayoutCard/Card with another title; cockpit uses the brief directly. Source shows duplicated surface/title hierarchy, although its actual visual impact is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Review the existing card/brief composition contract with the shared owner before flattening presentation. Preserve both specialist titles, all narrative, freshness, states, badges, metrics and Review details actions; do not remove sections or invent a new card.

architectureIssues.detail: Park's ten-minute historical accounting is labeled Live vehicle state; heartbeat also combines current fields with historical tick evidence. DataProvenanceBadge updatedAt is query success time, not telemetry observation time; cockpit scope explicitly admits observation time is not supplied.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve current source semantics while describing mixed live/history accounting accurately. Do not repurpose dataUpdatedAt as observation time, invent freshness metadata or weaken confirmed-Park eligibility. Any backend freshness/coverage addition is integration-owned.

architectureIssues.detail: Export scope is not explained in the UI: useSessionCertificate supplies only selected vehicle, while the handler defaults to thirty days and caps both source lists at 1000. The route is intentionally not range-enabled for its live readings. This does not establish an incorrect export, but makes scope/completeness opaque.
architectureIssues.fix: Expose actual certificate from/to and server-established limitations without making the live cockpit a historical page or adding a second date picker. If broader certificate scope/completeness is needed, coordinate typed integration and shared workspace ownership; do not claim full-range coverage.

Retry cockpit and park source through cockpitQuery.refetch

dataBehavior: Keep all nine cockpit readings: gear, detailed/normal charge fallback, latch/open fallback, battery percentage, independent pack voltage/current, energy remaining Wh, driving distance m and speed m/s.
Keep heartbeat distance, nullable last tick, firmware, server label/honesty and nullable valet/service mode semantics; FSD distance never implies engagement.
Keep confirmed Park, neutral rolling, reported-versus-counted sentry/overheat/preconditioning badges, park honesty and every rejected reason.
Numeric null remains unknown, not zero. Preserve meaningful numeric zero, sign and specialist formatting; preserve nullable mode inputs rather than infer false from absence.
Preserve raw SI in API/cache/export and existing display-only useUnits/useNumberFormatting. Do not change saved unit/locale/theme settings.

Preserve certificate vehicle_id, issued_at, from, to, rules, drives/charges, nullable ended_at and hmac_sha256, integrity_sha256 and honesty unchanged. Do not fabricate signatures, close open sessions, infer missing ledger values or claim complete export eligibility.
Preserve selected-vehicle scope keys, enabled guards, request AbortSignal, historical/live policy, retained payloads, fatal-versus-refresh errors and independent-source recovery.
Keep shell-owned vehicle selection; route currently has vehicle scope and no workspace range. Historical windows here are backend-owned; do not silently alter them during presentation modernization.
Preserve honesty/context text and all detail drawers. Unknown source eligibility remains unknown.
